title: Wastewater Treatment & Environmental Engineering Hardware
description: Sintered porous tubular/filter elements, filter press tie rods, pump impellers with complex curved vanes, shaft sleeves, sludge scraper blades, mist eliminator grid frames, orifice plates
designPrinciples: Material: Grade 2 (CP-Ti) for sintered filter elements, demister frames, and sludge scrapers. Grade 5 for pump impellers, tie rods, and shaft sleeves requiring high strength and cavitation resistance.
Form: Ti powder metallurgy for sintered filters. Bar/forging stock for tie rods and shaft sleeves. Investment casting or CNC machining for pump impellers. Sheet fabrication for demister grids.
engineeringTrends: Process: Powder compaction + sintering for porous filter elements
Process: CNC machining of impeller profiles (5-axis)
Process: Thread rolling of tie rods
comparisonNotes: Standards: ASTM B348 Grade 5 (tie rods/impellers) / ASTM B265 Grade 2 (filters/sheets), 100% PMI + pressure tested
relatedCapabilities: Powder compaction + sintering for porous filter elements
